_comment: Fill in admin_url and enrollment_key from your admin console's Deployment page (http://<your-admin-console>/deployment), then remove this _comment line - it's ignored by the loader either way, but a real JSON file shouldn't need it. device_id is optional; omit it and each host will fall back to --id, or you can assign one per machine here if you're templating this file per-device rather than per-org.
